description:
The debut compilation album from Daytimers features tracks from 28 artists of South Asian heritage. 
100% of proceeds from each purchase will be donated to Restless Beings http://restlessbeings.org/

From laid-back R&B grooves & trip-hop soundscapes, to rave-ready jungle rollers & grime instrumentals; this project seeks to showcase just how deep the talents of our community run. 

A massive thank you to all the artists who have contributed to this project and made it such an eclectic body of work.

BONUS PUNJABI GARAGE TREAT FOR ALL FULL ALBUM PURCHASES...
